in_marathi.name: Vishvakarma
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Universal Architect and Creator
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishvakarma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The divine architect and creator of the universe, Vishvakarma, is known for his immense knowledge and skill in designing and building everything from temples and palaces to cosmic structures.
